title: Incredible quality for this item I am surprised!
text: Incredible quality for this item I am surprised!. This might be really strange but I had a really hard time finding these baskets at the store and honestly even online as well in here too. There are so few that are actually good quality and good price, these are a little over the price I was expecting to pay for this but for the quality and material they are great I am not sure what kind of material it is but it's perfect it is not like a normal basket though so if you want it for the material maybe don't buy these but if you want it to use they look really flexible and sturdy I would recommend completely! I have a really hard time finding these and these surpassed my expectations.

product_metadata.title: GRANNY SAYS Imitation Wicker Baskets with Handles, Medium Hand-Woven Storage Baskets, Trapezoid Decorative Baskets, Walnut, 12" x 9" x 5.5", Set of 2
features: Moisture-proof material makes decorative baskets can be used in the kitchen, living room, bathrooms and outdoors.
Perfect for holding roll paper, hand towels, vegetables, fruits, DVDs, snacks, and more.
Crafted from hand-woven and finished in a natural colorway, suitable for all types of decor.
Storage baskets feature handles for easy, convenient transportation in your home, kitchen, RV, or somewhere else.
The woven baskets can be stacked and stored to save space when not in use.
